title: Pack 4 field map and responsive workspace
notes: Redesigned LSD, well and disposal map markers with distinct shapes, letters and labels so marker meaning is not dependent on colour alone.
Added map clustering for disposal facilities and surface wells, with custom disposal and well cluster markers and offline-cached Leaflet marker-cluster support.
Added keyboard-focusable map markers with accessible titles, stronger focus states, meaningful well and disposal card labels and minimum 44 px interaction targets.
Improved default field contrast and added visible On/Off filter state labels for sunlight readability and non-colour-only status communication.
Added optional persistent Field Mode with larger controls, higher contrast, enlarged map markers and reduced visual clutter for outdoor use.
Added a tablet landscape split layout with the live map beside scrollable job, well, disposal and saved-location details.
Added a desktop three-panel workspace with Search and Saved on the left, the map in the centre and active location details on the right.
Added reduced-motion support and preserved the existing mobile bottom navigation and sheet interactions.
Preserved Pack 1 through Pack 3 lookup, offline, IndexedDB, saved-location and universal-search behavior.
Kept the Field Mode toggle at the same 44 px minimum touch-target standard on phones instead of allowing the top-bar control to shrink.
